comment: P5.5 frozen scene set. 5 scenes inherited verbatim from P5.3 (experiments/2026-07-14-multi-candidate-select/scenes.json: same clip, f0, t_p, distractor_box) + 1 new scene (car9:560) curated 2026-07-14 (see curation/ contact sheets + grid frames). f0 = 0-based frame index (frame file = f0+1 as %06d.jpg; GT line = f0+1). distractor_box = hand-annotated pixel box at f0 (1280x720). Target seed is gt[f0] (oracle seed, recorded scope cut, unchanged from P5.1/P5.3). prompt = f0 + t_p*30. target_caption/distractor_caption are the MC-arm captions; old_* fields (present only where a caption changed vs P5.3) are the M-arm captions for the attribution runs. gating=false marks the resolution-bound control (car3:200) excluded from the verdict counts.
